Headline: Crude Oil and Silver CFD Trading Party: Trade to Claim 20 USDx and Win Up to 5,000 USDT
Prize pool: 5,000 USDT
Start: 2026-11-18T09:00:00Z · End: 2026-12-02T09:00:00Z
Most one person can get (parsed): 5000 USDT
Smallest threshold (parsed): 10000 USD (trade)
OFFICIAL RULES TEXT:
Explore trading opportunities in crude oil and silver. After registering, trade XBRUSD, XTIUSD, and XAGUSD CFDs and meet the trading requirement to claim 20 USDx. Your cumulative trading volume can also qualify you for the trading volume leaderboard, where you can share a 10,000 USDT prize pool and win up to 5,000 USDT per person. Rewards are limited.
Join Now
## Event Period: November 18, 2026, 09:00 – December 2, 2026, 09:00 (UTC)
## CFD Instruments for This Event: XBRUSD, XTIUSD, XAGUSD
## Event 1: Trading Welcome Reward | Meet the Target to Claim 20 USDx
During the event, users who register and reach a cumulative trading volume of at least 10,000 USDx in designated CFDs will receive a 20 USDx CFD Trading Fee Rebate Voucher. Limited to the first 3,000 users. Rewards are issued automatically on a first-come, first-served basis while supplies last.
## Event 2: Trading Volume Leaderboard, Earn Up to 5,000 USDT
During the event, users who register and reach a cumulative trading volume of at least 50,000 USDx in designated CFDs will qualify for the trading volume leaderboard. Users will be ranked by cumulative CFD trading volume from highest to lowest, and the top 100 will receive the corresponding rewards. The total prize pool is 10,000 USDT in spot tokens. Rewards are limited and available while supplies last.
Note: If multiple users have the same cumulative trading volume, rankings will be determined by who first reached the 50,000 USDx leaderboard entry threshold.
Rank | Individual Reward (USDT Spot Tokens)
1st Place | 5,000 USDT
2nd–3rd Place | 1,000 USDT
4th–10th Place | 200 USDT
11th–20th Place | 50 USDT
21st–50th Place | 20 USDT
51st–100th Place | 10 USDT
## Important Notes
All participants must complete Identity Verification before registering, then select [Join Now] to register for the event. Due to local policies and service coverage limitations, participation and registration are temporarily unavailable in some regions.
Trading volume = buy volume + sell volume. Only trading volume generated in XBRUSD, XTIUSD, and XAGUSD CFDs after registration counts toward this event. Trading volume from other CFD instruments does not count.
[Event 1] Rewards are issued as CFD Trading Fee Rebate Vouchers with a 10% rebate rate and will be automatically credited to users' accounts after they complete the applicable task. [Event 2] Rewards are issued as USDT spot tokens. The button text will not change after task completion, and rewards will be credited to users' accounts within 14 business days after the event ends and data review is complete. If a reward is not credited, it means all rewards have been claimed or the participation requirements were not met.
Gate TradFi services may be restricted in certain jurisdictions, and users in some regions may be temporarily unable to use this feature. Trading traditional financial instruments involves market volatility, leverage risk, and liquidity risk. Before enabling TradFi trading, carefully read the Contract for Difference (CFD) Service Agreement, the Risk Disclosure Statement, and the terms for each asset.
Users who participate in other Gate events of the same type at the same time can receive rewards from only one event.
Gate will review accounts, trades, and fund transfers during the campaign. Prohibited conduct includes using multiple accounts to participate repeatedly, impersonating others or submitting false identity verification documents, self-trading or wash trading, recycling on-chain funds, coordinating to obtain rewards improperly, repeatedly transferring funds, and any other conduct that undermines the fairness of the campaign. If a violation is confirmed, Gate reserves the right to disqualify the users involved from receiving rewards.
Market makers, companies, and institutions are not eligible to participate in this event.
If there is any discrepancy between a translated version and the English version, the English version prevails.
Gate reserves the right to interpret the terms of this event.
Users in the United Kingdom and other restricted regions cannot use all or part of the services (including participation in this event, games, or contests). For details about restricted regions, please read the User Agreement.

Bitget Onchain trading challenge round 135 (Robinhood) is now live! Trade any coin on the Robinhood chain during the promotion to earn chances to open Mystery Boxes. Every Mystery Box contains a U crypto voucher worth up to 100 U. New users get an exclusive reward too, and everyone can climb the trading leaderboard for a share of generous U rewards, with up to 1000 U per user!
Promotion period: November 18, 2026, 2:00 PM – November 25, 2026, 12:00 AM (UTC+8)
Eligible coins: all coins on the Robinhood chain
Join now
## 1. Exclusive new-user reward
During the promotion, users who register and complete their first-ever Onchain trade pay zero net transaction fees, with up to 5 USDT in net fees waived per user.
## 2. Trade to open Mystery Boxes
During the promotion, every Mystery Box contains a U crypto voucher worth up to 100 U. Rewards are limited and available on a first-come, first-served basis until they run out.

## 3. Trading leaderboard
During the promotion, registered users will be ranked by their total trading volume in eligible coins. Users who meet a tier's requirements receive its rewards.
Ranking | Individual reward (U) | Minimum trading volume (USDT)
1st–3rd | 1000 | 250,000
4th–5th | 700 | 200,000
6th–10th | 400 | 150,000
11th–20th | 120 | 50,000
21st–50th | 60 | 30,000
## 4. Promotion details
Users must select "
" to register before they can participate in the promotion. Only Onchain trading orders placed after successful registration will be counted.
Mystery Box rewards are issued instantly when each box is opened. New-user rewards and trading leaderboard rewards will be distributed within seven working days after the promotion ends.
Users who have completed Onchain trades before registering for the promotion will be considered existing users. Only orders placed after registration count toward the promotion.
If separate promotions are offered for new and existing users, new users making their first trade are eligible only for new-user rewards. They cannot receive existing-user rewards, even if they make additional trades during the promotion. However, if both a new-user promotion and an all-user promotion are available, new users who meet the eligibility requirements for both may receive rewards from both promotions.
Sub-accounts, institutional users, and market makers are not eligible for this promotion. API trading volume is also excluded from the calculations.
For Onchain signal copy trading, eligible orders are buy orders placed on the Onchain signals page and automated take-profit and stop-loss (TP/SL) orders that use Onchain signals. Copy orders can currently be placed only in the Bitget app.
PnL during the promotion = realized PnL during the promotion. ROI = total realized PnL ÷ total buy amount of the realized portion. Only users with positive PnL are eligible for ranking.
In the ending-number promotion, users have a 10% chance of receiving a reward. The ending numbers will be announced within one day after the promotion ends.
Rewards will be distributed to eligible accounts within seven working days after the promotion ends. Users can find their rewards in their Onchain account.
All participants must strictly comply with Bitget's Terms and Conditions. Bitget reserves the right to disqualify any user from participating in the promotion and confiscate their rewards if any fraudulent conduct, illegal activities (such as using multiple accounts to claim rewards), or other violations are found.
Bitget reserves the right, at its sole discretion, to change or revise the promotion terms or cancel the promotion at any time without prior notice.
Bitget reserves the right of final interpretation regarding this promotion. Contact our customer service if you have any questions.

Headline: Global Markets Rebound Watch : 48-Hour Trading Challenge
Start: 2026-11-18T10:00:00Z · End: 2026-11-20T10:00:00Z
Smallest threshold (parsed): 100 USD (trade)
OFFICIAL RULES TEXT:
The Global Markets Rebound Watch campaign is now live. Register during the campaign period and trade the global-market stocks and ETFs designated on the campaign page to complete tasks and earn draw chances. Each valid draw wins one item from the prize pool, including DIA, VOO, or QQQ stock trial funds, or a trading fee rebate voucher. Prizes are limited and available until the pool is exhausted. See the campaign page for prize-pool details and distribution arrangements.
Join Now
## Event Period: November 18, 2026, 10:00 – November 20, 2026, 10:00 (UTC)
## Lucky Draw: Complete Tasks, Win Stock Tokens and Fee Rebates
During the campaign, users earn draw entries by completing the following tasks:
Task Type | Completion Criteria | Draw Entries
First Transfer | Complete your first-ever transfer into your stock account during the campaign, with the first transfer ≥ $100 | 1 (max 1)
First Trade | Complete your first-ever stock trade during the campaign, with the first trade volume ≥ $100 | 1 (max 1)
Daily Check-in | Daily cumulative stock trading volume ≥ 1,000 | 1 (max 1 per day)
All-Users Trading | Cumulative stock trading volume reaches 500 / 10,000 / 50,000 / 100,000 | 1 / 3 / 6 / 10
- The prize pool is updated daily at 00:00 (UTC) ; once that day's prizes are drawn, unused draw entries roll over to the next prize-pool refresh. If all prizes are drawn on the final day, the campaign ends automatically.
## Important Notes
- Users must complete identity verification before registering by clicking “Join Now” on the campaign page. Eligible regions are subject to the campaign page.
- Only valid trades of campaign-designated assets made on Gate Stocks during the campaign period after registration will count. Eligible markets, stocks, and ETFs are listed on the campaign page. Unfilled orders, canceled orders, off-platform trades, asset transfers, and trades in non-designated assets do not count toward trading volume.
- Cumulative valid trading volume equals the total buy value plus sell value of designated assets, converted to USDT equivalent according to the platform’s calculation method at the time of execution. Gate’s system records determine execution time and conversion.
- The first-transfer and first-trade tasks can each be completed once. Daily check-ins are counted by UTC+8 calendar day and are limited to once per day.
- Cumulative trading-volume chances are awarded according to the highest tier reached and do not stack with lower tiers. The accumulation method, total cap, and validity period for draw chances are subject to the campaign page.
- Prizes include DIA, VOO, and QQQ stock trial funds, and a 5 USDT trading fee rebate voucher. Eligible products, minimum tradable share quantity, validity period, and the handling of trial-fund principal and profits are subject to the trial-fund product rules and voucher details. The rebate voucher’s eligible scope, usage requirements, and validity period are subject to its terms.
- Prize quantities are limited. Distribution will stop when the prize pool is exhausted. See the campaign page for prize quantities and distribution progress.
- Gate will review accounts, trading activity, and fund movements during the campaign. Prohibited conduct includes participating more than once using multiple accounts, using another person’s identity or submitting false verification documents, self-trading or wash trading, recycling on-chain funds, organizing schemes to claim rewards improperly, repeatedly transferring funds, and any other conduct that undermines the fairness of the campaign. If a violation is confirmed, Gate reserves the right to disqualify the users involved from receiving rewards.
- Stocks and related products involve market, liquidity, foreign-exchange, and regulatory risks. This campaign does not constitute investment advice, a promise of returns, or a recommendation of any market or asset. Please participate according to your risk tolerance.
- Reward distribution timing is subject to the campaign page. Gate reserves the right to amend, suspend, or cancel the campaign within the scope permitted by applicable laws and platform rules. Changes will be announced on official channels. Some or all services may be unavailable to users in restricted regions.
